notes: SVGs are intentionally lightweight, text-free visual assets.
Career labels, eligibility, source facts, and translations remain in the application data.
Raahi mascot assets are not replaced or duplicated by this library.

fashion_tech.purpose: Career Routes card and Kavya's primary pathway landmark

garment_supervisor.purpose: Career Routes card and adjacent Kavya pathway landmark

iti_sewing.purpose: Career Routes card and practical training pathway landmark

textile_design_digital.purpose: Career Routes card and creative pathway landmark

route_primitives.route-start.svg: Talk, Don't Type start point and pathway origin
route_primitives.direction-arrow.svg: Non-interactive direction cue at a route end

map_elements.field-atlas-contours.svg: Low-contrast desktop presenter topographic contour layer
map_elements.field-atlas-route.svg: Non-interactive dotted Field Atlas route layer
map_elements.crop-row-horizon.svg: Abstract rural landscape/crop-row atmosphere; not a literal location

integration_rules.preferred_loading: Use img width/height or CSS aspect-ratio; lazy-load below-the-fold career cards.
integration_rules.decorative_assets: Mark map and landscape layers aria-hidden and keep pointer-events none.
integration_rules.fallback: If a career asset is missing, preserve the current text/card layout and do not block rendering.
integration_rules.mobile_budget: Keep one active career card illustration plus required route primitives in the first view; avoid preloading the full library.
